nodes.name: Monday 06:00 Schedule
nodes.notes: Weekly Monday 06:00 server time. Set TZ=Asia/Kolkata.

nodes.name: Fetch 12 Months Lead Pipeline
nodes.notes: Pull pipeline leads (NEW, ASSIGNED, CONTACTED, QUALIFIED) for forecast input

nodes.name: Fetch Active Distributor Roster
nodes.notes: Distributor count + tier distribution — input for forecast capacity model

nodes.name: Build Forecast Prompt
nodes.notes: Builds 4-week forecast prompt: monthly sales + lead pipeline + distributor roster. Asks AI for forecast[], insights[], risks[], recommendations[], assumptions[].

nodes.name: Parse Forecast
nodes.notes: Parses AI forecast response. Falls back to empty arrays if AI fails.

nodes.name: Save Forecast to Analytics
nodes.notes: POST /api/analytics/sales-forecast — persists forecast for trend analysis + dashboard

nodes.name: Broadcast Forecast to Dashboard
nodes.notes: Push forecast update to admin dashboard websocket subscribers

meta.description: Weekly Monday 06:00 AI sales forecast. Gathers last 12 months of monthly sales, active lead pipeline counts, distributor roster + tier distribution. Calls AI to generate 4-week forward forecast with insights, risks, recommendations, assumptions. Saves to analytics, emails sales team, broadcasts to admin dashboard.
